title: Yarn TLS certificate validation disabled
description: .yarnrc.yml declares a Yarn setting that disables certificate validation. Any host able to answer on the path is accepted as the registry, so an intercepted connection looks exactly like the real one.
remediation: Re-enable strict TLS and trust the corporate CA explicitly.
limitation: It matches a Yarn setting that disables certificate validation in the parsed .yarnrc.yml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
